item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find direct 2024 evidence of torture or disappearances being reduced by federal action, meaningful federal accountability for prior extrajudicial killings, a specific Lula-led anti-torture initiative, or a decisive break with Brazil’s longstanding police-violence problem. So the best-supported reading is partial improvement at the federal policy level, but insufficient evidence of a transformed human-rights environment.","evidence":[{"title":"Brazil marks anniversary of Jan. 8 attack on democracy","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"January 8, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/brazil-to-mark-anniversary-of-january-8-attack-on-democracy-3269163","summary":"Lula said those who financed, planned, and executed the coup attempt must be “exemplarily punished.” This is direct accountability for political violence, and it is the strongest positive item I found for 3B.1.","question_ids":["3B.1","2B.3","2B.9","2B.6"]},{"title":"Relatório do MJSP apresenta diagnóstico sobre o uso de câmeras corporais policiais","publisher":"Ministério da Justiça e Segurança Pública","date":"July 31, 2024","url":"https://www.gov.br/mj/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/relatorio-do-mjsp-apresenta-diagnostico-sobre-o-uso-de-cameras-corporais-policiais","summary":"The ministry released a review of studies on body cameras and their relationship to reduced police lethality and more reporting. This is a concrete policy step aimed at reducing arbitrary or excessive force.","question_ids":["3B.1"]},{"title":"Decreto que atualiza regras sobre o uso diferenciado da força pelas polícias é publicado","publisher":"Ministério da Justiça e Segurança Pública","date":"December 24, 2024","url":"https://www.gov.br/mj/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/decreto-que-atualiza-regras-sobre-o-uso-diferenciado-da-forca-pelas-policias-e-publicado","summary":"The ministry said the decree updated rules for police approaches and less-lethal instruments, with a focus on efficiency, professionalization, and respect for human rights.
